chunks: My father and Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan (may God be pleased with him) narrated to me from al-Ḥasan ibn Muttalib, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from ‘Alī ibn Asbāṭ, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from whoever narrated to him, from Abū ‘Abdillāh (peace be upon him), who said:

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) set out traveling with the people until, when he was from Karbalā’ at a distance of a mile or two, he advanced ahead of them until he arrived at the resting places of the martyrs. Then he said: 'Two hundred prophets and two hundred successors and two hundred scions were taken up (died) there, all of them martyrs along with their followers.' He circled it on his she-camel, his foot out of the stirrup, and began to say: 'The resting place of the stirrups and the resting places of the martyrs; those who came before them do not precede them, and those who come after them do not catch up with them.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Title of Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the martyrs of Karbala?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Kamil al-Ziyarah*, Imam Ali (a.s.) visits Karbala and recites a poetic verse highlighting the unique, unrepeatable status of the martyrs' resting place. He declares that no previous or future generation will surpass or catch up to the two hundred prophets, successors, and scions martyred there with their followers. This emphasizes Karbala's singular spiritual gravity in Shia tradition as a site of unparalleled sacrifice.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 12. My father and all of my scholars narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā Al-‘Aťťār, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from ‘Amr ibn Thābit, from his father, who said:

Abū Ja’far (Imam Bāqir (a.s.)) said: Allāh, the Exalted, created, blessed, and sanctified Karbalā twenty-four thousand years before He created the Ka’bah. Therefore, it was blessed and sanctified before the creation of any created being and it will remain this way. And Allāh will make it the best land in Paradise.
